meta.subject: english
meta.author: Zakharevich Igor
meta.disclosure: Авторские тренировочные наборы этого приложения не являются официальными материалами РИКЗ и не выдаются за них. Формат подготовки повторяет структуру теста по английскому языку (18 A + 22 B, 120 минут), но задания составлены автором приложения.
meta.structureSource: РИКЗ, «Перечень и коды учебных предметов …», форма № 3, Английский язык: 18 A + 22 B = 40 заданий, 120 минут — https://result.rikc.by/ru/documents/filesofregpunkts/rce_2025/form__3.pdf (проверено 2026-10-14)

tasks.text: She ___ in Minsk since 2019.

correction.ru: «since 2019» — Present Perfect: действие началось в прошлом и продолжается.
correction.en: “since 2019” takes Present Perfect: it started in the past and still continues.

tasks.text: Look! The children ___ football in the yard.

correction.ru: «Look!» — сигнал действия прямо сейчас: Present Continuous.
correction.en: “Look!” signals an action happening now: Present Continuous.

tasks.text: By the time we arrived, the film ___.

correction.ru: Действие раньше другого прошедшего — Past Perfect.
correction.en: An action earlier than another past action takes Past Perfect.

tasks.text: I ___ my keys, so I could not open the door.

correction.ru: Потеря произошла до того, как стало невозможно открыть дверь.
correction.en: The loss happened before the door could not be opened.

tasks.text: This time tomorrow we ___ to Warsaw.

correction.ru: «This time tomorrow» — процесс в будущем: Future Continuous.
correction.en: “This time tomorrow” describes an action in progress: Future Continuous.

tasks.text: You ___ take an umbrella: it looks like rain.

correction.en: A piece of advice takes “should”.

tasks.text: Passengers ___ smoke on board: it is prohibited.

correction.en: A strict prohibition takes “must not”.

tasks.text: She ___ swim when she was five.

correction.en: Past ability takes “could”.

tasks.text: It is late; he ___ be at home already.

correction.en: A confident deduction takes “must”.

tasks.text: You ___ not have shouted at her; she was right.

correction.ru: Упрёк о прошлом — «should not have + V3».
correction.en: A reproach about the past takes “should not have + V3”.

tasks.text: The bridge ___ built in 1897.

correction.ru: Дата в прошлом, единственное число — «was built».
correction.en: A single object and a past date take “was built”.

tasks.text: The letters ___ sent tomorrow morning.

correction.ru: Будущее время в пассиве — «will be + V3».
correction.en: A future passive takes “will be + V3”.

tasks.text: The room ___ cleaned already.

correction.ru: Результат к моменту речи — «has been + V3».
correction.en: A result up to now takes “has been + V3”.

tasks.text: Such mistakes ___ often made by beginners.

correction.en: A plural subject and a general fact take “are made”.

tasks.text: The window ___ by the storm last night.

correction.ru: Окно не действовало само: нужен пассив «was broken».
correction.en: The window did not act itself, so the passive “was broken” is required.

tasks.text: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.

correction.ru: В условии I типа будущее не употребляется: «if it rains».
correction.en: A first conditional uses the present in the if-clause: “if it rains”.

tasks.text: If I were you, I ___ apologize.

correction.en: An unreal second conditional takes “would + V”.

tasks.text: She said that she ___ busy the next day.

correction.ru: Косвенная речь: будущее сдвигается в «would be».
correction.en: Reported speech shifts the future to “would be”.

tasks.text: He asked me where I ___ from.

correction.ru: В косвенном вопросе время сдвигается назад.
correction.en: A reported question shifts the tense back.

tasks.text: If he had studied harder, he ___ the exam.

correction.ru: Нереальное условие III типа — «would have + V3».
correction.en: A third conditional takes “would have + V3”.

tasks.text: She is interested in ___ new languages.

correction.en: A preposition is followed by the gerund: “interested in learning”.

tasks.text: I would like ___ this book.

correction.en: “Would like” takes the infinitive.

tasks.text: He avoided ___ about the accident.

correction.en: “Avoid” requires the gerund.

tasks.text: The letter ___ yesterday arrived too late.

correction.ru: Причастие прошедшего времени: письмо, которое отправили.
correction.en: A past participle describes the letter that was sent.

tasks.text: ___ the news, she called her mother.

correction.en: An action earlier than the main one takes the perfect participle.

tasks.text: We usually have ___ breakfast at seven.

correction.ru: С приёмами пищи артикль не нужен.
correction.en: Meals take no article.

tasks.text: He is ___ honest man.

correction.en: “Honest” starts with a vowel sound, so it takes “an”.

tasks.text: ___ sun rises in the east.

correction.ru: Единственное в своём роде — определённый артикль.
correction.en: A unique object takes the definite article.

tasks.text: She plays ___ piano very well.

correction.en: Musical instruments after “play” take “the”.

tasks.text: I need ___ advice.

correction.en: “Advice” is uncountable and takes no article.

tasks.text: The result depends ___ the weather.

correction.en: “Depend on” is a fixed collocation.

tasks.text: She is good ___ mathematics.

correction.en: “Good at” is a fixed collocation.

tasks.text: I am interested ___ history.

correction.en: “Interested in” is a fixed collocation.

tasks.text: The meeting was postponed ___ Friday.

correction.en: “Postpone until” marks the new moment in time.

tasks.text: He has been working here ___ 2015.

correction.en: “Since” takes a starting point; “for” takes a period.

tasks.text: This is my sister. ___ name is Olga.

correction.en: A feminine possessive determiner is “Her”.

tasks.text: There are ___ students in the group than last year.

correction.en: Countable nouns take “fewer”.

tasks.text: He did the task ___ without any help.

correction.en: The reflexive pronoun of the third person is “himself”.

tasks.text: My birthday is on the ___ of May.

correction.en: An ordinal numeral is “twenty-first”.

tasks.text: Neither the teacher ___ the students were late.

correction.en: The paired conjunction is “neither … nor”.

tasks.text: This information is very ___.

correction.en: After “is” an adjective is required.

tasks.text: She speaks English ___.

correction.en: A verb is modified by an adverb.

tasks.text: These ___ are my friends.

correction.en: “People” is the plural of “person”.

tasks.text: He is the ___ student in our group.

correction.en: The superlative degree is “the best”.

tasks.text: There is too ___ sugar in my tea.

correction.en: Uncountable nouns take “much”.

tasks.text: She answered the question ___ (CONFIDENT).

tasks.text: It is ___ (POSSIBLE) to finish this work in one day.

correction.en: The negative meaning is formed with the prefix: impossible.

tasks.text: The ___ (INVENT) of the telephone changed the world.

correction.en: A noun of action is required: invent → invention.

tasks.text: My brother is keen ___ playing chess.

correction.en: The fixed collocation is “keen on”.

instruction.en: Fill the gap with one word.

tasks.text: We had ___ wait for an hour because of the rain.

correction.en: “Had to wait” expresses obligation in the past.

instruction.en: Fill the gap with one word.

tasks.text: She has lived in Gomel ___ five years.

correction.en: A period of time takes “for”.

instruction.en: Fill the gap with one word.

tasks.text: It was the first time that I ___ seen such a performance.

correction.ru: «It was the first time that I had seen».
correction.en: The pattern is “It was the first time that I had seen”.

instruction.en: Fill the gap with one word.

tasks.text: The more you practise, the ___ you speak.

correction.en: The pattern is “the more …, the better …”.

tasks.text: In a time bank, where everyone becomes both a giver and a receiver.

correction.ru: Придаточное «where» разрывает предложение без главной части.
correction.en: The clause with “where” leaves the sentence without its main part.

instruction.ru: Найдите лишнее слово в строке и впишите его.
instruction.en: Find the extra word in the line and type it.

tasks.text: Participants can spend their time credits on the skills they need it.

correction.ru: «They need» уже имеет дополнение «the skills»; «it» лишнее.
correction.en: “They need” already has the object “the skills”; “it” is extra.

instruction.ru: Найдите лишнее слово в строке и впишите его.
instruction.en: Find the extra word in the line and type it.

tasks.text: He has been living in this city since many years.

correction.en: “Many years” takes “for”, so “since” is extra.

instruction.ru: Найдите лишнее слово в строке и впишите его.
instruction.en: Find the extra word in the line and type it.

tasks.text: The more carefully you drive, the less fewer accidents happen.

correction.en: After “less” a second comparative word is extra.

instruction.ru: Найдите лишнее слово в строке и впишите его.
instruction.en: Find the extra word in the line and type it.

tasks.text: She told me that she will would come later.

correction.en: Reported speech replaces “will” with “would”.

tasks.text: — Thank you very much for your help. — ___

correction.en: The standard reply to thanks is “You are welcome”.

tasks.text: — I am sorry I am late. — ___
options: It does not matter to me.

correction.ru: Извинение принимают словами «That is all right».
correction.en: An apology is accepted with “That is all right”.

tasks.text: Read the notice: “The library is closed for repairs until 5 May.” Where can you borrow books?

answer.value: The library is not open until 5 May.

accepted: The library is not open until 5 May.
options: The library is not open until 5 May.
Books are sold in the library.
The library moved to another city.
The library closes only on Sundays.

correction.ru: «Until 5 May» — до этой даты библиотека закрыта.
correction.en: “Until 5 May” means the library stays closed before that date.

tasks.text: The sign says “Queue here for tickets”. What should you do?

answer.value: Stand in the line to buy a ticket.

accepted: Stand in the line to buy a ticket.
options: Stand in the line to buy a ticket.
Ask the driver for a ticket.

correction.ru: Объявление указывает, где встать за билетом.
correction.en: The notice tells you where to stand to buy a ticket.

tasks.text: — Would you like some tea? — ___

correction.en: A polite acceptance of an offer is “Yes, please”.

tasks.text: By the end of next year he ___ here for a decade.

correction.ru: «By the end of …» + длительность — Future Perfect.
correction.en: “By the end of …” with a duration takes the Future Perfect.

will work.ru: Future Simple не выражает «к концу срока»
will work.en: Future Simple does not mark completion by a deadline

tasks.text: I ___ the letter when the telephone rang.

correction.ru: Действие в процессе, которое прервал звонок — Past Continuous.
correction.en: The interrupted action in progress takes the Past Continuous.

tasks.text: You ___ have told her the truth; now she is upset.

correction.ru: Упрёк о невыполненном действии — «should have + V3».
correction.en: A reproach about the past takes “should have + V3”.

tasks.text: The new stadium ___ opened next month.

correction.ru: Стадион не открывает сам себя: будущее в пассиве.
correction.en: The stadium does not open itself: the future passive is required.

tasks.text: If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.

correction.ru: Третье (нереальное) условие: had + V3 в условии.
correction.en: The third conditional takes “had + V3” in the if-clause.

tasks.text: They suggested ___ the meeting until Monday.

correction.en: “Suggest” takes the gerund.

tasks.text: She has been playing ___ violin since childhood.

correction.en: Instruments take “play the violin”.

tasks.text: Our success depends ___ careful planning.

correction.en: “Depend on” is a fixed collocation.

tasks.text: He is responsible ___ the whole project.

correction.en: “Responsible for” is a fixed collocation.

tasks.text: The company presented ___ new programme yesterday.

correction.en: “Its” is possessive; “it's” means “it is”.

tasks.text: ___ of the two candidates was suitable for the post.

correction.ru: Из двух — «neither» с глаголом в единственном числе.
correction.en: Out of two, “neither” takes a singular verb.

tasks.text: The instructions were so ___ that nobody understood them.

correction.en: Instructions are confusing; people feel confused.

tasks.text: This year the harvest is ___ than last year.

correction.en: The comparative form of “good” is “better”.

tasks.text: The train ___ at 6:40 every morning.

correction.en: A timetable takes the Present Simple.

tasks.text: The documents ___ signed before the meeting started.

correction.ru: Раньше другого прошедшего действия — Past Perfect Passive.
correction.en: Earlier than another past action: the Past Perfect Passive.

tasks.text: He asked whether I ___ ever been abroad.

correction.ru: Косвенный вопрос сдвигает время назад: «had ever been».
correction.en: A reported question shifts the tense back: “had ever been”.

tasks.text: — I am terribly sorry for the delay. — ___

correction.ru: Извинение принимают: «That is quite all right».
correction.en: An apology is accepted with “That is quite all right”.

tasks.text: The notice says: “Last admission is at 17:30; the museum closes at 18:00.” When must you enter?

correction.ru: «Last admission 17:30» — входить нужно до этого времени.
correction.en: “Last admission 17:30” means you must enter before that time.

tasks.text: Their ___ (KIND) impressed everybody.

correction.en: An abstract noun is formed with “-ness”: kindness.

correction.en: The verb “spoke” needs the adverb “angrily”.

correction.en: Before a noun an adjective is required: historic centre.

correction.en: The negative form is “impossible”.

tasks.text: My cousins are fond ___ reading adventure stories.

correction.en: The fixed collocation is “fond of”.

instruction.en: Fill the gap with one word.

tasks.text: The lesson starts ___ nine o'clock sharp.

correction.en: A clock time takes “at”.

instruction.en: Fill the gap with one word.

tasks.text: You needn't ___ taken the umbrella: the rain has stopped.

correction.en: “Needn't have + V3” marks an unnecessary past action.

correction.en: “Be used to doing” expresses a habit.

correction.ru: «Be used to doing something» требует предлог «to».
correction.en: “Be used to doing something” requires the preposition “to”.

correction.en: “Since” takes a starting point in time.

tasks.text: The teacher explained us the rule twice.

correction.ru: «Explain» требует «to»: explain the rule to us («us» без предлога лишнее).
correction.en: “Explain” takes “to”: explain the rule to us, so bare “us” is extra.

tasks.text: Переведите на английский: «Он сказал, что придёт позже».

answer.value: He said that he would come later

accepted: He said that he would come later
He said he would come later
He said that he would come later.

correction.en: Reported speech shifts “will” to “would”.

tasks.text: Переведите на английский: «Если бы я знал ответ, я бы помог тебе».

answer.value: If I knew the answer, I would help you

accepted: If I knew the answer, I would help you
If I knew the answer I would help you
If I knew the answer, I would help you.

correction.ru: Нереальное условие II типа: if + Past Simple, would + V.
correction.en: The second conditional: if + Past Simple, would + V.
